note.p: Among the Abinger Manusripts there is a printed proposal, dated 1828, to publish the Letters, Critical, Philological and Literary of the Eighteenth Century, by Edward Richard Poole, BA, Trinity Hall, Cambridge. On the last blank leaf Poole has written to Godwin, complicating matters by writing first horitontally across the page, and then writing over that lengthways. We have identified Edward Poole as the E Poole in the diary first noted in 1828. Godwin he seems to differentiate clearly between this E Poole and his older associate John Poole (whom he continues to see in theatrial circles, linked to the Kenney's, and so on). He sees E Poole occasionally until 1833.
For a full discussion of the Pooles in the diary see Thomas Poole.
